evidence: Shell currently controls sidebar navigation and scroll-to-section behavior that the proposal should replace with route-owned navigation.
Root dashboard route should become an overview page and route-aware navigation entry.
Current topic route should be expanded or nested so topic sections have URL/history-owned pages.
Root layout should own persistent shell/navigation while routed pages render through Outlet.
Router already enables scroll restoration and should remain the browser history boundary.
Both participate in the TanStack Router route tree and root layout.
One-page overview/topics/documents/graph workflow should be split into route-rendered pages and reusable panels.
Document preview/source tabs and reference summaries are part of content navigation and Markdown reading UX.
Markdown anchor rendering currently uses native title attributes and should provide themed popovers for evidence references.
MarkdownPreview resolves cartographer-ref tokens through referenceLinkProps and reference resolver helpers.
Route targets and popover descriptions should reuse the existing reference resolution model.
Route-owned pages should consume existing read-only TanStack DB collection hooks rather than duplicating fetch state.
Graph exploration should become addressable via browser history and shareable links instead of a hidden tab in the giant page.
Existing themed tooltip wrapper can inform or be extended for evidence-hover presentation.
Tooltip content uses bg-popover/text-popover-foreground tokens defined in globals.css.
UX improvements should preserve and extend the existing dark tactile theme tokens and responsive polish.
Navigation behavior changes require updated browser-mode assertions for Link/history behavior and active route state.
Markdown link hover/popover and removal of native title behavior should be covered by Markdown/document viewer tests.
Page split should preserve server-rendered overview/topic/document panels.
Graph route/page split should preserve graph explorer behavior and inspector affordances.
Dashboard work should target TanStack Start routes and read-only TanStack DB projections.
The route/page split should use existing typed router dependency rather than adding a second router.
Evidence hover behavior should be implemented through the existing Markdown renderer component override path.
Existing Radix tooltip primitives can provide accessible hover/focus reference descriptions without native title UI.
Mermaid support should use the official Mermaid renderer/registry rather than a custom subset parser so current diagram types and features are supported.
MarkdownPreview code rendering is the integration point for mermaid code fences and SVG output.
